assertions.assert: <autonomy:behavior_input_payload> takes exactly its declared attributes, the required ones present and none empty, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/autonomy.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<autonomy:behavior_input_payload> writes the stimulus data's members when the data is an object (not an array), else {event: data}, with focus and focus_candidates set to the values given (one that is undefined left out); a stimulus that is not an object raises error.execution and assigns nothing.
